newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia targets 2005 sales of 20 trln won.
newsitem.headline: Kia targets 2005 sales of 20 trln won.

text.p: Kia Motors Corp, one of South Korea's top three car makers, said on Wednesday it has targetted sales of 20 trillion won in the year 2005, compared with 5.7 trillion won in 1995.
Kia aims to post sales revenue of 7.4 trillion won this year.
"We hope operating profits would account for about 5 percent of our sales by 2005," Kia said in a statement.
Kia said its annual production capacity would rise to 2.1 million units, against 1.03 million units at present.
It said it planned to export about 60 percent of its production to about 180 countries, compared with the current 40 percent.
The production capacity for 2005 was a downward revision from an earlier target of 2.6 million units.
